name: Blast Tumbler
description: A hard-to-reach rune is placed on the lock's tumbler. It emits a blast of force when the door is jostled.
disable: DC 32 Thievery (master) to disarm the rune, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune's magic.
reset: The rune resets 1 minute after it triggers.

generalAbilities.name: Force Blast
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A non-undead creature opens the door or critically fails an attempt to disarm or dispel the rune

Effect A 30ft Cone of force issues forth from the lock. Creatures within the cone must succeed a Basic DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw or take 8d12 Force Damage damage. Those who fail the save are pushed 10 feet, and those who critically fail are pushed 20 feet and are Stunned 2.
